name: matfile
title: matfile
summary: Create a MAT-file object for whole-variable reads and writes.
description: `matfile(filename)` returns a `matlab.io.MatFile` compatibility object. RunMat supports `m.Properties`, whole-variable dot reads such as `m.A`, and whole-variable dot assignment when the object is constructed with `'Writable', true`.

signatures.label: m = matfile(filename)
signatures.description: Create a read-only MAT-file object for `filename`.

signatures.label: m = matfile(filename, 'Writable', tf)
signatures.description: Create a MAT-file object whose whole-variable dot assignments write Level-5 MAT-file data.

options: `Writable` accepts a scalar logical or numeric value. When false or omitted, dot assignment through the object is rejected.
Dot reads load a complete variable from the MAT-file, preserving the existing `load` builtin's Level-5 MAT-file type support.

examples.output: A contains the variable loaded from data.mat.
The MAT-file is rewritten with updated whole variables.

notes: RunMat currently supports Level-5 MAT-files through the shared `load` and `save` MAT encoder/decoder.
Partial MAT-file reads/writes that avoid loading the full variable, HDF5-backed v7.3 MAT-files, `who(m)`, and `whos(m)` remain future MAT-file object work.
gpu_residency: `matfile` is host file I/O. GPU-resident assignment values are gathered before MAT-file serialization.
